description.value: Circle K is a 24-hour convenience store and petrol station on Lorimer Road in Whistler, part of the international Circle K (Couche-Tard) chain. The location offers grab-and-go snacks, coffee, roller grill hot food, and lottery services alongside fuel. Its round-the-clock availability and central Whistler location make it a practical resupply stop for cyclists at any hour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Circle K store locator page confirms the location at 4370 Lorimer Road, Whistler, with phone +16049055692. The website explicitly lists services including Public Restrooms, Fresh Food Fast, Coffee, and Roller Grill, confirming hot food and washrooms. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water bottle refill, ice, camping fuel, vending machines, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
Website page title incorrectly reads 'WHISTLER, United States' despite the address showing postal code V8E 1A6 (Canada) and country code CA — likely a website data entry error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A 24-hour convenience store with hot food, restrooms, and snacks in central Whistler is a useful resupply point for touring cyclists; meets the Groceries category threshold.
